name: Vietnam
shortSummary: India and Vietnam share a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership dating to Cold War-era solidarity, with substantial defence cooperation including training support and lines of credit, and joint interest in South China Sea freedom of navigation.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: ONGC Videsh holds exploration blocks in Vietnamese waters.
India supports Vietnamese naval and air force capacity building.

majorChallenges.title: South China Sea tensions
majorChallenges.description: Indian oil exploration blocks off Vietnam's coast have drawn objections from China.

recentDevelopments.title: Continued defence and maritime cooperation
recentDevelopments.description: India and Vietnam sustained defence training cooperation and joint naval engagement amid shared concern over Chinese assertiveness in the South China Sea.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: One of India's most consistent Southeast Asian defence partnerships, unaffected by broader regional volatility.

historicalEvents.title: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations
historicalEvents.description: India and Vietnam formalise diplomatic relations amid Cold War-era non-aligned solidarity.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic Partnership
historicalEvents.description: Ties are elevated to a Strategic Partnership.

historicalEvents.title: Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
historicalEvents.description: Relations are upgraded further during PM Modi's visit to Hanoi, alongside a $500 million defence line of credit.

agreements.name: Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
agreements.description: Framework elevating political, defence and economic cooperation.

agreements.name: Defence Line of Credit
agreements.description: $500 million credit line to support Vietnamese defence acquisitions from India.

defenceCooperation.name: VINBAX
defenceCooperation.description: Bilateral army exercise between India and Vietnam.

defenceCooperation.name: Naval training assistance
defenceCooperation.description: India trains Vietnamese submarine crews and provides naval vessels.

multilateralRelations.detail: India engages Vietnam through the ASEAN framework and Act East Policy.
